nodes.description: Address of the AlchemyRetort contract, set once in initialize and used as the target of unwrapToken.
Address of the attestation verifier, set in initialize and updatable via reconfigure.
Sequential token id counter, initialized to 1 and incremented on every mint.
Mapping from token id to RemixCommit, written on mint and deleted on burn.
Owner address from OwnableUpgradeable, read by onlyOwner and _authorizeUpgrade.
ERC721 balance mapping mutated by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
Initializer that wires retort/verify addresses, calls __Ownable_init and sets _tokenIdIndex.
onlyOwner function that swaps the verification attestation contract address.
Mints a token sequentially; gated by msg.sender == _alchemyRetort, stores commitment and bumps index.
Burns a token, calls external unwrapToken on the retort before clearing state.
Builds token metadata URI from _alchemyURI, block.chainid, contract address and token id.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted to onlyOwner.
UUPS external upgrade entrypoint that authorizes and delegates to upgrade logic.
UUPS payable upgrade entrypoint with a forced follow-up delegate call.
Internal ERC721 mint that increments _balances and writes ownership.
Internal ERC721 burn that clears approvals, decrements _balances and deletes owner.
Internal transfer that shifts balances and ownership after clearing approvals.
Private helper that performs an external onERC721Received call to receiver contracts.
ERC721 transfer entrypoint checking caller approval then calling _transfer.
Internal approval writer that updates _tokenApprovals and emits Approval.
Private helper executing a delegatecall into the new implementation address.
Caller-controlled address used for mint gating, burn approval, ownership and upgrade authorization.
External call to the retort performed inside burn before local state is cleared.
Low-level delegatecall executed by the UUPS upgrade flow into a caller-supplied implementation.
Balance decrement in _burn; Solidity 0.8 checked arithmetic.
Sequential token id increment in mintUsingSequentialTokenId.
Retort address parameter of initialize.
Verify attestation address parameter of initialize.
New verify attestation address parameter of reconfigure.
Recipient address parameter of mintUsingSequentialTokenId.
RemixCommit struct parameter describing the retort commitment.
Token id parameter of burn.
Token id parameter of tokenURI.
Local tokenId assigned from _tokenIdIndex and returned by mint.
Local interface instance created from the _alchemyRetort state address.
Local owner address obtained from ownerOf(tokenId) inside burn.
Mapping from token id to approved address, written by _approve.

edges.reason: initialize consumes the alchemyRetort parameter.
initialize consumes the verifyAttestation parameter.
alchemyRetort parameter is assigned to state variable _alchemyRetort.
verifyAttestation parameter is assigned to state variable _verifyAttestation.
reconfigure consumes the verifyAttestation parameter.
reconfigure writes the new verifyAttestation parameter into _verifyAttestation.
msg.sender is compared against _alchemyRetort to gate minting.
msg.sender is validated through _isApprovedOrOwner before burning.
mintUsingSequentialTokenId consumes the to parameter.
mintUsingSequentialTokenId consumes the commitmentEntry parameter.
mintUsingSequentialTokenId creates the local tokenId.
Local tokenId is read from _tokenIdIndex.
to parameter is forwarded into _mint.
Local tokenId is forwarded into _mint.
commitmentEntry parameter is stored into _tokenCommitmentIds.
Local tokenId indexes the _tokenCommitmentIds mapping key.
mintUsingSequentialTokenId performs the _tokenIdIndex increment operation.
The increment result is written back to _tokenIdIndex.
burn consumes the tokenId parameter.
tokenId parameter drives existence and approval checks in burn.
burn creates the local owner from ownerOf(tokenId).
burn creates the local alchemyRetort interface instance.
State address _alchemyRetort is copied into the local call target.
burn performs the external unwrapToken call before clearing _tokenCommitmentIds.
The local retort address is the target of the unwrapToken external call.
The stored RemixCommit is passed as calldata into unwrapToken.
burn invokes _burn after the external call.
_burn executes the _balances decrement operation.
The balance decrement writes the _balances mapping.
_mint increments _balances for the recipient.
upgradeTo invokes _authorizeUpgrade before upgrading.
upgradeToAndCall invokes _authorizeUpgrade before upgrading.
msg.sender is checked by onlyOwner inside _authorizeUpgrade.
The _owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check.
upgradeTo reaches the delegatecall helper during upgrade execution.
upgradeToAndCall reaches the delegatecall helper for the forced call.
The helper performs the raw delegatecall into the new implementation.
transferFrom validates msg.sender is approved or owner.
transferFrom delegates the actual move to _transfer.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping of sender and receiver.
_transfer clears the previous approval via _approve.
_approve writes the approved address into _tokenApprovals.
_burn clears approvals by calling _approve.
msg.sender is forwarded as the operator argument of onERC721Received.
The receiver callback re-enters with the original msg.sender during safe transfers.
tokenURI consumes the tokenId parameter.

normalization_plan.reason: The alchemyRetort parameter only exists to seed initialize and is folded into that core function.
The verifyAttestation parameter of initialize is merged into the core initialize function.
The verifyAttestation parameter of reconfigure is merged into the core reconfigure function.
The to parameter belongs to the core minting function and carries no standalone semantics.
The commitmentEntry parameter is part of the mint flow and merges into mintUsingSequentialTokenId.
The tokenId parameter is the identifier operand consumed by the core burn function.
The tokenId parameter is only used to build the URI in the core tokenURI function.
The local tokenId is a temporary of the mint flow and merges into mintUsingSequentialTokenId.
The local retort interface exists solely to trigger the external call inside burn.
The local owner value is derived and used only within the core burn function.
